A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING

Let’s clear
things up.

Where do you provide cleaning services?+

We cover Malta and Gozo. Include your location and requirements so we can confirm availability and discuss the right arrangement.

Can you clean multiple properties?+

Yes. We work with property managers, condominium administrators and businesses. Share the locations and scope of your portfolio with us.

Do you offer one-off and regular cleaning?+

Both can be discussed. Tell us whether you need a one-time service or a daily, weekly, fortnightly, monthly or customised schedule.

How do I get a price?+

Every quotation is tailored to the service, property and frequency. Complete the quotation form and send the prepared request through WhatsApp, or contact us by email.
